environment: Windows 11 Pro x64, MSVC 14.51, loopback, real wall-clock time for soak runs
game_exe_sha256: N/A (prototype does not touch the game)
objective: Verify and address ChatGPT review #2 (FB-2-01 manifest validation, FB-2-02 timeout-notice robustness, FB-2-03 budgets) and re-run the soak under gate version 2.
hypothesis: FB-2-01: analyzer v1 can pass a run whose client never started. FB-2-02: a delayed or replayed Disconnect{Timeout} after a successful reconnect forces a spurious reconnect.
procedure: 1) FB-2-01: ran analyzer v1 (git HEAD 39287be) on a synthetic run where client2 never started; then analyzer v2. 2) FB-2-02: wrote fake-host tests first and ran them on the unfixed client; then added the accept-sequence guard. 3) ./scripts/test.ps1 -Repeat 3 -E2E; python -I tools/soak/test_analyze.py; ./scripts/soak.ps1 -Profile lan|moderate|harsh -DurationS 120 under gate v2 into fresh directories.
expected_result: v1 passes the broken run and v2 fails it; notice tests fail before the guard and pass after; all v2 soak gates pass.
observed_result: FB-2-01 confirmed: analyzer v1 printed 'SOAK PASSED' for a run with no client2 log and a null client2 exit code; v2 fails it (manifest, log set, exit-code coverage). FB-2-02 confirmed: delayed_timeout_notice_after_reconnect_is_ignored and replayed_and_duplicate_timeout_notices_have_no_extra_effect FAILED on the unfixed client and pass with the guard. The real-host jitter test passed both before and after (it delivered no late notice: stale_notices=0), so it is kept only as a smoke test. Suites: unit 15, integration 25, network 12 all passed (x3 + E2E); analyzer self-checks 11/11. Soak v2: soak-2026-10-23-204617-lan-g2: gate v2 PASSED (36 gates); client1 rtt p50/p99 10.5/12.1 ms; recovery 18.0 ms; max correction 0.000 (budget 0.84); in/out 21.61/13.66 kbit/s (budgets 22.93/31.0); shed 0 | soak-2026-10-23-204825-moderate-g2: gate v2 PASSED (36 gates); client1 rtt p50/p99 103.9/121.6 ms; recovery 161.0 ms; max correction 0.333 (budget 1.4); in/out 21.05/22.22 kbit/s (budgets 23.39/31.0); shed 8 | soak-2026-10-23-205033-harsh-g2: gate v2 PASSED (36 gates); client1 rtt p50/p99 203.9/241.6 ms; recovery 1567.0 ms; max correction 0.333 (budget 2.0); in/out 19.2/29.39 kbit/s (budgets 24.08/31.0); shed 110. Gate v1 summaries from EXP-010 are untouched.
follow_up: FB-2-05 (longer, randomized, host and OS-level stalls) and a versioned tighter RTT benchmark gate after repeated runs; LAN run pending approval.
